name: pidgeon
description: Pidgeon — open-source desktop email client with AI

scripts.build: bun run --filter @pidgeon/shared build && bun run --filter @pidgeon/crypto build && bun run --filter @pidgeon/db build && bun run --filter @pidgeon/services build && bun run --filter @pidgeon/desktop build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @pidgeon/crypto test && bun run --filter @pidgeon/services test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @pidgeon/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @pidgeon/crypto typecheck && bun run --filter @pidgeon/db typecheck
